Whether you work from home or in your company's meeting room, HALO VX10 video bar is your best choice! It is integrated with one 4K AI camera, dual powerful stereo speaker and four noise-cancelling microphones, meeting all your needs for a smooth and productive video conference.

Built with dual full-frequency stereo speakers, HALO VX10 video bar can deliver loud and full human voice, so you can hear every word clearly from your far-end colleagues or business partners. In addition to business conference, you can also use it to play your favorite music, refreshing yourself in leisure time.

The full-duplex design allows conversations to flow just as they do in person. Especially in a multi-person video conference, the conversations from every side are transmitted naturally and clearly at the same time. It ensures effective communication and improves teamwork efficiency.

With all-in-one design, HALO VX10 video bar's compact dimensions and graceful curves integrate beautifully into huddle rooms and small meeting rooms. It comes with adjustable mounting bracket, so you can easily place it on a desk, or mount it onto a TV or monitor.

HALO VX10 video bar is also compatible with various operating systems, including Mac OS and Windows 7/8/10/11. It is plug and play, no driver required. Connect it to your computer via USB-C cable and you can hold a video conference right away.

Built with dual full-frequency stereo speakers, HALO VX10 video bar can deliver loud and full human voice, so you can hear every word clearly from your far-end colleagues or business partners. In addition to business conference, you can also use it to play your favorite music, refreshing yourself in leisure time.

Enable the unique presenter tracking mode on #WyreStorm HALO# software when you have an online presentation at home. Wherever you stand to present and move around, the camera lens can automatically follow you in real time and ensure your image remains in the center.

You can also enable the unique speaker tracking mode on #WyreStorm HALO# software when in your company's meeting room. The camera can automatically pick out the active speaker from your team and ensure the speaker's image remains in the center. It provides a natural flow to the conversation, allowing the far end to see the speaker and body language better.

The full-duplex design allows conversations to flow just as they do in person. Especially in a multi-person video conference, the conversations from every side are transmitted naturally and clearly at the same time. It ensures effective communication and improves teamwork efficiency.

With all-in-one design, HALO VX10 video bar's compact dimensions and graceful curves integrate beautifully into huddle rooms and small meeting rooms. It comes with adjustable mounting bracket, so you can easily place it on a desk, or mount it onto a TV or monitor.

HALO VX10 video bar is also compatible with various operating systems, including Mac OS and Windows 7/8/10/11. It is plug and play, no driver required. Connect it to your computer via USB-C cable and you can hold a video conference right away.

Auto framing is designed for meeting room scenario. When someone enters or leaves the meeting room, the camera lens can automatically reframe to present an optimal view. It can ensure all attendees are clearly reflected in the image and also put in the appropriate position.

Presenter tracking is designed for one lecturer scenario. Wherever you stand to present and move around, the camera lens can automatically follow you in real time and ensure your image remains in the center.
